title: Advantech WebAccess viewsrv SQLGetData Untrusted Pointer Dereference Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Advantech WebAccess Node. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the 0x27F4 IOCTL in the webvrpcs process.
